decisions.decision: The Town would like two more quotes for the Eagle House parking lot project.
decisions.quote: the town would like two more quotes for the project.

decisions.decision: Lloyd Carlson will investigate whether the Friends of the Eagle House could cash in a CD early and incur a penalty fee.

decisions.decision: Doreen Noble will look into applying for a grant to have the building go green.

budget_items.topic: Parking lot project plans (McKenzie Engineering quote)
budget_items.what_was_recorded: A McKenzie Engineering quote for drawing up the project plans was given at $35,000.
budget_items.quote: a quote from mckenzie engineering was given for the cost to have the proper plans drawn up for the project and it would be $35,000.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: The project could ultimately cost up to $150,000 to complete; the minutes say the price might be reduced by using Town Departments for parts of construction.
budget_items.quote: it was also determined that it could ultimately end up costing upwards to $150,000 to complete the project.

budget_items.topic: Friends of the Eagle House start-up money request
budget_items.what_was_recorded: The Town asked whether the Friends of the Eagle House could provide approximately $15,000 in start-up money to begin the grant application process.
budget_items.quote: the town inquired whether or not the friends of the eagle house inc. could provide start up money of approximately $15,000 in order to begin the grant application process.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Utility bills received are becoming a huge drain on the budget; no figures printed.
budget_items.quote: doreen stated that the utility bills that have been received are becoming a huge drain on the budget.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Budget packages expected from the Town Manager in about eleven days; the FY11 budget would be bare bones. No figures printed.
budget_items.quote: she also stated that fy11's budget would be "bare bones".

budget_items.topic: Property Tax Work Off program funding
budget_items.what_was_recorded: The Property Tax Work Off Committee has $12,000 in funding; each participant receives up to $750 off their property tax bill; sixteen elders had applied.
budget_items.quote: they have $12,000 in funding for the program.
